evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never delivers the framing 'This will take about 10 to 15 minutes, and you can walk away with a quote you can depend on. Does that sound good to you?' Instead jumps directly to 'in order for me to give you an on target estimate. So, I need to ask a few questions first that might take around ten to fifteen minutes maybe, okay?' — no wait for confirmation or promise of dependability.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Rep asks: moving day (Thursday/Friday/Saturday this week), items (three sofa chairs, two recliners, love seat), and gets two of three zip codes early (75069, 75071, 76227). Does NOT ask customer name until much later, and never asks for a recognizable city-to-city route summary upfront — the route emerges piecemeal through zip code collection.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep never asks 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?' Moves directly into logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection. Customer mentions mattress movement within house and chairs to two different locations, but rep never reflects back 'So what I'm hearing is...' to confirm understanding.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Rep gathers: property type (one-story at first location, one-story at second, two-story apartment at third), floor/stories (second floor of apartment with staircase access), some room/access details (driveway parking available), items being moved. Missing: walking distance at any location, additional rooms in the homes, comprehensive special considerations documentation.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep asks 'would you need help packing or this theres are all ready to go?' — customer declines. Item is checked as asked.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Not asked. Rep confirms 'no boxes' but never asks the box-count / overflow check question ('typical box count for a home your size is _____, do you have anything like china or a book collection that might put you over a typical count?').
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep provides $510 for 2.5 hours, plus $115 transportation fee = $625 total, or $727 for 3 hours. This is personalized (long distance, multiple stops, transportation fee) but lacks a typical-range anchor ('homes your size usually run between X and Y').
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep mentions trip fee / transportation fee upfront ($115). Does NOT mention 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute-increment commitment, or 'this is not a guess' framing.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Rep never asks 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing. Moves directly to 'If you're okay with that, I can fill you in for the remaining slot.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep never says 'Does that put those to rest?' or closes Section 5 explicitly. Two Promises section is entirely absent.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep never asks 'What's still concerning you about this move?' or any genuine variant. No final concerns checkpoint occurs.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' before closing.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Rep never asks 'Would you like our help with your move?' Instead, moves straight to 'Alright then one second ma'am, in order for me to book this, I need to gather your information.' This is a booking assumption with no explicit ask for the business.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirms: name (Amanda Routon), phone (817-253-3780), email (Amanda@Gamenergs.com), all three pickup/dropoff addresses, stories/floors, items at each location, and time window (Friday 12:00 PM–2:00 PM, Oct 2). Missing: arrival window precision (only a 2-hour block), crew size, and notes to crew about customer concerns (which were never probed).

top_strength: Rep systematically gathered all three addresses with zip codes, confirmed property types, floor levels, and parking access — the logistics probing was thorough and customer-specific, ensuring the estimate would be accurate despite the complex multi-stop move.
coaching_note: Rep must lead with the quid-pro-quo framing and wait for a yes before probing, probe for the customer's own agenda and concerns (Section 2) before jumping into logistics, and deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before closing — three foundational sections were either skipped or severely compressed, and the call skipped straight to booking without an explicit ask for the business.
